projects.title: SWIR Hyperspectral Imaging (Pushbroom)
summary: **Goal:** Develop a SWIR hyperspectral imaging platform for material discrimination and find optimized wavelength for quantum dot image sensors.
**Key Results:** Spectral-cube Acquisition, PCA & Wavelength Scoring for chemometrics
**My Role**: Optical layout design and alignment, hardware integration, Acquisition software development, Cube analysis
**Design Insight**: Connected wavelength-dependent material responses with spectral imaging
**Skills:** Hyperspectral Imaging, Ray Optics Simulation, Optical system alignment, Instrument Control, Python.

projects.title: SWIR Multispectral Imaging
summary: **Goal:** Pioneering applications, where visible imaging fails.
**Key Results:** SWIR Multispectral Imaging System.
**My Role**: Planning application, Optical design/assembly, characterization, and physics-guided data analysis.
**Design Insight**: Optical system design guide through electromagnetics including Fresnel equation.
**Skills:** Ray Optics Simulation, Electromagnetic Calculation, Image Processing, Algorithm Development, Python.

projects.title: SPAD for Low-light spectroscopy
summary: **Goal:** Evaluate a 1 × 256 SPAD array prototype for low-light spectroscopy and compare its performance with a cooled CCD.
**Key Results:** Characterized 20% PDP with a 25cps/㎛² DCR, 1㎲ scale acquisition, Temperature coefficients of 10mV/K.
**My Role**: Evaluation-system setup, control and analysis software development, optical and electrical characterization, and operating-condition optimization.
**Design Insight:** Examined photon-detection performance, dark counts, and temperature dependence to assess operating trade-offs for low-light spectroscopy.
**Skills:** Photon-Counting Sensor Characterization, Noise Analysis, Temperature-Dependence Analysis, Instrument Control, Python.
Status: On hold while SWIR and HSI projects take priority.

projects.title: SWIR Image Sensors based on Quantum Dot
summary: **Goal:** Develop PbS quantum-dot SWIR image sensors and identify device and operating factors that limit imaging performance.
**Key Results:** Contributed to a 512 × 512 SWIR sensor prototype, with a responsivity of 0.5 A/W at 1300 nm and a dark current density of 200nA/cm².
**My Role:** Optoelectronic characterization, physics-based performance analysis, collaborative device architecture design, measurement automation.
**Design Insight**: Analyzed image quality dependency on various parameters such as bias, temperature, exposure time, gain to identify performance bottlenecks.
**Skills:** Semiconductor Device Physics, Image Sensor Characterization, Performance Modeling, Image Processing, Python.
We are currently preparing to commercialize this image sensor.

projects.title: Direct X-Ray Detectors based on Quantum Dot
summary: **Goal:** Developing monolithic image sensors using the PbS QDs(quantum dots) for X-Ray mammographic detectors.
**Key Results:** 40µC/(Gy·cm²) sensitivity with 5nA/cm² dark current density.
**My Role:** Device architecture design, optoelectronic evaluation, property analysis to guide subsequent design stages.
**Design Insight**: Analyzed photodetector performance dependency on various parameters such as material composition, thickness, bias to direct design.
**Skills:** Monolithic Image Sensors, X-Ray Sensor Modelling & Characterization, X-Ray Imaging, Image Processing, Python.
We are currently investigating the QD size effect on X-Ray detection performance.

projects.title: Metasurface for High Spatial Resolution indirect X-Ray Detectors
summary: **Goal:** Addressing the fundamental limitation in spatial resolution of indirect X-Ray detectors caused by isotropic radiation within scintillators.
**Key Results:** Simulated an MTF increase from 0.15 to 0.60 at 2 lp/mm for a 400 µm-thick scintillator and a sensor with 124 µm pixel pitch.
**My Role:** Concept proposal, FDTD scattering analysis, COMSOL-based metasurface design, light-propagation modeling, and PSF/MTF analysis.
**Design Insight**: Connected electromagnetic structure design with detector-level spatial resolution through light-propagation and imaging-performance models
**Skills:** Electromagnetic Simulation, Metasurface Design, Nanophotonics, PSF/MTF Modeling, COMSOL, FDTD. Python.
Status: On hold while SWIR and HSI projects take priority.

projects.title: Surface Enhanced Raman Scattering for Point of Care Testing
summary: **Goal:** Improve the reproducibility of SERS measurements from gold nanoparticles in liquid using a laser Scanning Raman system.
**Key Results:** Reduced the coefficient of variation of Raman-peak intensity from 40% to 15% through spatiotemporal ensemble averaging.
**My Role:** SERS physics analysis, optical-system development and alignment, scanning integration, instrument control, data analysis.
**Design Insight**: Investigated near- and far-field behavior and particle-motion effects to connect SERS physics with optical measurement design.
**Skills:** Electromagnetic modeling, SERS Analysis, Raman Instrumentation, Optical-System Integration, Python.

projects.title: Graphene based Optoelectronic Device
summary: **Goal:** Empirically demonstrating photodoping effect in a graphene-perovskite heterostructure.
**Key Results:** photodoping level of approximately 3×10¹²/cm² at zero gate bias (Fermi energy variation from 0.37 to 0.43eV).
**My Role:** Device design, Fabrication, Optoelectronic Evaluation, Property Analysis.
**Design Insight**: Energy band alignment to maximize photodoping effect.
**Skills:** Device Design, Fabrication, Evaluation, Analysis, Labview.
